entities.name: Ryusaki Kumano
entities.description: Powerful old yamabushi on Kamigawa, once the disowned son of a samurai family.

entities.name: Reito
entities.description: Town Kumano wandered and fled; annihilated the day after.

entities.name: Untaidake Peak
entities.description: Mountain peak in the Sokenzan Range the kami told him to flee to.

entities.name: Kakkazan
aliases: Great Kami of the Mountain Fire

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Kami whose rage the visiting kami sought to understand.

entities.name: Fire kami
entities.description: Kami who told Kumano to flee to Untaidake Peak.

events.summary: In 3207 AR a fire kami tells Kumano to flee to Untaidake Peak before the veil is torn; he leaves Reito.
events.quote: he was paid a visit by a fire kami . The kami spoke to him, telling him to flee to Untaidake Peak before the veil was torn.

events.summary: Reito is annihilated the day after Kumano fled; he learns years later.
events.quote: It would be years before he learned that Reito had been annihilated the day after he fled.

events.summary: Kumano is visited by kami seeking the reason for O-Kagachi's rage; he fights Kakkazan and resolves to leave and find who lied.
events.quote: After the yamabushi's fight with Kakkazan , Great Kami of the Mountain Fire, Kumano decided it was time to leave his plateau

relations.quote: After the yamabushi's fight with Kakkazan
